title: CSS Class vs ID: Which Should You Use?
description:
Compare CSS classes and IDs with a beginner code example. Reuse a class across elements and keep each ID unique.

To style three matching cards, would you choose a class or an ID?

Next lesson: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tozXzYirna4
Full beginner course: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLEJDqf_3IqMU

A dot selects a class; a hash selects an identifier.
Reuse a class to apply the same style to several elements.

Try it: Style two elements with one shared class.
